question: What master's degrees does Ramapo offer and how many credits is each one?
answer:
The catalog lists these master’s programs [6]; Graduate Admissions also lists them except the Creative Music Technology MFA [7]. Published credit counts:
- Master of Business Administration (MBA): 42 credits [8].
- Master of Social Work (MSW): 64 credits [11].
- Master of Science in Nursing (MSN): 34/35 credits [12].

The catalog also lists Accounting MS, Applied Mathematics MS, Computer Science MS, Creative Music Technology MFA, Data Science MS, Public Policy MPP, and Special Education MA [6]. The pages provided do not state their credit counts. The Special Education MA is also listed by Graduate Admissions [7].

Graduate Admissions can help confirm unlisted credit counts: graduate@ramapo.edu; (201) 684-7270 [9].

question: im a working nurse with a BSN, what graduate nursing programs do you have and what courses are in the MSN
answer:
Ramapo lists the Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) and Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) among its graduate programs [7]. The MSN catalog lists Adult/Gerontology, Family Nurse Practitioner, Nursing Administration and Nursing Education tracks, plus a post-master’s program for nurses with a master’s in nursing interested in nursing education [3]. The graduate page instead lists three tracks: Family Nurse Practitioner, Nursing Education and Nurse Administration; the pages differ on the number and names of tracks [3][4]. The MSN is 34/35 credits, online with some hybrid features; fall, spring and summer starts [4][5].

MSN courses listed in the catalog [3]:
• Adult/Gerontology: NURS 611 Science and Research; 620 Advanced Health Assessment; 635 Advanced Pathophysiology; 640 Advanced Pharmacology; 645 Primary Care of Adults I; 646 Primary Care Adults Practicum I; 647 Primary Care of Adults II; 648 Primary Care Adults Practicum II; 650 Primary Care of Adults/Geriatrics III; 651 Primary Care of Adults/Geriatrics Practicum III; 652 Family Centered Primary Care IV; 655 Context of Healthcare for Advanced Practice; 657 Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Practicum IV; 710 Role Practicum.
• FNP: the Adult/Gerontology courses plus NURS 653 Family Centered Primary Care Practicum IV.
• Nursing Administration: NURS 611 Science and Research; 643 Program Evaluation; 655 Context of Healthcare for Advanced Practice; 660 Leadership and Innovation in Healthcare; 665 Quality Improvement in Healthcare; 670 Healthcare Economics and Finance; 675 Strategic Management in Healthcare Orgnaization; 680 Human Resource Management in Healthcare; 710 Role Practicum; and a program elective.
• Nursing Education: NURS 611 Science and Research; 620 Advanced Health Assessment; 622 Educational Technology; 632 Curriculum Development; 634 Psychometrics; 635 Advanced Pathophysiology; 640 Advanced Pharmacology; 643 Program Evaluation; 710 Role Practicum.

Sources: [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-MSN-NURM) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/home/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/home/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/)

question: I'm applying for the master's in data science (if that exists). What courses are required and how long does it take part time?
answer:
Yes. Ramapo lists the Data Science MS, a Master of Science [1]. Also published: Data Science 4+1, Data Science BS, and Data Science Minor [1].

Required courses [1]:
• Core: all six—CMPS 530 PYTHON FOR DATA SCIENCE; CMPS 664 ADVANCED DATABASE AND BIG DATA SYSTEMS; DATA 601 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE; DATA 620 ETHICS IN DATA & COMPUTING; MATH 570 APPLIED STATISTICS; MATH 680 ADVANCED MATHEMATICAL MODELING.
• Technical electives: select 2—CMPS 531 DATA STRUCTURES & ALGORITHMS; CMPS 547 FOUNDATIONS OF COMPUTER SCIENCE; CMPS 620 MACHINE LEARNING; CMPS 645 ANALYSIS OF ALGOITHMS; DATA 590 TOPICS or DATA 690 TOPICS; DATA 670 DATA VISUALIZATION; DATA 687 TIME SERIES DATA; DATA 730 DATA SCIENCE FIELDWORK I; MATH 540 CRYPTOGRAPHY; MATH 562 APPLIED LINEAR ALGEBRA; MATH 645 NUMERICAL ANALYSIS; MATH 654 APPLIED PROBABILITY; MATH 685 INTRODUCTION TO EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN.
• Interdisciplinary elective: select 1—BADM 501 DATA ANALYTICS; DATA 730 DATA SCIENCE FIELDWORK I; EDLD 602 BEST PRACTICES IN CURRICULUM PLANNING, DESIGN & DEVELOPMENT; EDLD 604 APPLIED RSRCH IN PRACTICE: USING DATA FOR CURR-BASED DECISION MAKING, PLANNING & RENEWAL; EDTC 633 DESIGN THINKING AND DATA ANALYSIS; DATA 730 DATA SCIENCE FIELDWORK I; MBAD 610 BECOMING A 21ST CENTURY LEADER; MBAD 612 LEADING CHANGE IN AN UNCERTAIN WORLD; MBAD 615 BUSINESS ANALYTICS; MSWK 645 ADVANCED SEMINAR OF TOPICS ADDRESSING SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS.
• Capstone: select 1—DATA 731 DATA SCIENCE FIELDWORK II, or DATA 745 DATA SCIENCE THESIS PROPOSAL and DATA 750 DATA SCIENCE THESIS [1].

The pages don't state a part-time completion timeline. Graduate students must complete their programs within five years; each program sets its annual progress requirement [7]. For clarification, contact Graduate Admissions: graduate@ramapo.edu; (201) 684-7270; text (201) 800-6057.

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-MS-DSCM) [7](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#graduate-student-academic-progress)

question: Can credits from a graduate certificate be applied toward the master's degree later, and how many transfer?
answer:
Ramapo says academic certificates are usually made up of credit-bearing courses, but the pages don’t specifically confirm whether credits earned in a graduate certificate will count toward a later master’s degree. [4]

For Ramapo master’s programs, the policy says it may be possible to apply Ramapo master’s-level coursework to two different master’s programs, up to 15 credits or 25% of the degree’s total required credits, whichever is greater. The coursework must meet the subsequent program’s criteria, and its Program Director must permit it. [2][5] The Program Director evaluates proposed transfer credit, and the decision is final, with no appeal. [5]

Office of the Provost: provost@ramapo.edu; (201) 684-7330; first floor of the Birch Mansion. [2]

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#certificate-programs1) [5](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#transferring-academic-credit1)

question: I have 30 credits from my previous master's at another school. Will you accept them, and how many credits would I still need for the MBA?
answer:
The MBA is listed as a Ramapo graduate program [1].

Your 30 credits are not automatically accepted. A course may be considered if its syllabus shows it is equivalent to a course in a Ramapo graduate program, and the course must be from another accredited higher education institution. The MBA Program Director must approve transfer credit; acceptance criteria vary by program. No more than 25% of the degree’s required credits may be considered for transfer, including GPLA credits [2, 4]. The pages don’t establish whether your particular credits will be approved.

The pages don’t state the MBA’s total required credits or how many you personally would still need. They describe a 30-credit MBA program for Advanced Standing only: a bachelor’s degree in Business is required; a Business minor and/or completed foundation Business coursework may be considered subject to MBA Program Director approval [5].

Graduate Admissions can direct you to the MBA Program Director: graduate@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7270 [4].

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/faqs/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/requirements/)
